$comment: The console markers the perf tooling parses: a name per `TN_*` line a producer prints and `threenative-playtest perf` and the evaluators read. Generation writes the TypeScript constants for playtest, core and three-native and the C++ macros from this file, so a rename lands in every language or the drift spec fails. Playtest must not import core, and core treats playtest as an optional peer, so each package gets a generated copy instead of an import.
